text:
emily: Quick intro  please welcome Diego Alvarez who starts today on Eng-ML (inference infra)! :tada:
diego alvarez: hey all  happy to be here. couple quick onboarding Qs: who do I ping for SSH key add to bastion, and is there a preferred IDE setup for model debugging?
nick: welcome Diego! I can add your public key to the bastion. paste it in the #help ticket or DM me. For IDE we usually recommend VS Code + remote-ssh.
diego alvarez: thanks @nick. also any gotchas for joining the private model registry? I tried the registry UI and got an access denied.
tonboarding-bot: New hire checklist: "Diego Alvarez" created. Items pending: SSH, GitHub org invite, 2FA, badge. Orientation: 2pm PT.
tanya: @diego I just sent the GitHub invite and registry access; check your email. If the registry UI 403s, clear cookies or try incognito; sometimes SSO needs a kick.
diego alvarez: saw the invites, thanks! fun fact: I used to do improv comedy in Austin  so expect terrible API puns later. :microscope::laughing:
leo: improv! we have a surprise improv fan club on the Eng-ML team apparently. :grin: @diego for infra runbooks ping me, i'll schedule a quick 30-min walkthrough. 4pm PT ok?
diego alvarez: 4pm works great, thanks @leo. one last thing  where's the GPU quota request form?
emily: GPU quota is a Google Sheet linked in the onboarding doc (pinned to #new-hires). If you need immediate access file a request in #help with "urgent-gpu" and tag @nick.
onboarding-bot: Reminder: New hire orientation at 2pm PT. "Diego Alvarez" is registered.
diego alvarez: awesome, appreciate the warm welcome everyone. excited to dig in! :wave:
